newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 2.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says will never accept "one country, two systems" as formula for reunification with mainland China.
Torrential rains in southern Taiwan cause crop damages.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Koo Chen-fu, Taiwan's unofficial representative in Hong Kong handover, will meet new Beijing-appointed Hong Kong chief Tung Chee-hwa on Thursday.
Four dead, two missing after recent southern rainstorms.
LIBERTY TIMES - "Divine tree" in Alishan mountain felled by rainstorms.
First day for new Hong Kong.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Five Taiwan diplomatic allies downgrade consulates in Hong Kong into trade offices following British colony's reversion to rule by Taipei's arch rival, Beijing.
Taiwan should keep close watch on developments in Hong Kong.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Chinese communist leader Jiang Zemin says Taiwan problem can be resolved under formula of "one country, two systems".
Hong Kong dollar remains firm against U.S. dollar following handover.
